panels.is: Shot 5, three-shot through the windscreen, just after the car slid round a corner. The woman in the middle back seat (red hair in a bun) says "Yeah, I didn't like that." with a small headshake; Jason (left, passenger) glances back at her. Flat cartoon house style: big front-on heads that show where they look by sliding the face toward that side (BoJack style); circle hands are the house style. No voices yet.

Shot 6, closer two-shot through the windscreen. Lucia (right, driving) asks Jason (left) "You want to tell me why we brought her again?": she looks at Jason. The woman in the middle back looks at Lucia. Flat cartoon house style: big front-on heads that show where they look by sliding the face toward that side (BoJack style); circle hands are the house style. No voices yet.

Shot 6. Jason says "I told you" to Lucia, eyes shut, exasperated; his face turned toward Lucia. Flat cartoon house style: big front-on heads that show where they look by sliding the face toward that side (BoJack style); circle hands are the house style. No voices yet.

Shot 6. Jason on "Her hyperfixation...": a thumb jabbed back over his shoulder at the woman behind, his face turned toward her. Lucia rolls her eyes.
